🔥 इमरान हाशमी की फिल्म के ट्रेलर लॉन्च को लेकर आई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर! 🎬

ट्रेलर मुंबई की बजाय पुणे के कोथरुड इलाके में स्थित City Pride मल्टीप्लेक्स में लॉन्च किया जाएगा 📍

ट्रेड सोर्स का दावा है कि पुणे में इमरान हाशमी की बहुत बड़ी फैन फॉलोइंग है और यह देश के टॉप परफॉर्मिंग सेंटर्स में से एक है 🌟

फिल्म का ट्रेलर 5 नवंबर को CBFC से ए सर्टिफिकेट के साथ पास हुआ है और इसका रनटाइम 2 मिनट 40 सेकंड है 🎞️

इस एक्शन एंटरटेनर में इमरान हाशमी के साथ जेनेलिया देशमुख और अपारशक्ति खुराना नजर आएंगे, और यह 27 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी 🍿

क्या आप पुणे में होने वाले इस ग्रैंड ट्रेलर लॉन्च को लेकर एक्साइटेड हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.text:
Emraan Hashmi bounced back as a hit machine with the recently released Awarapan 2 . The film was a huge success, so expectations are immense for his next, Gunmaaster G9 . The release of the film is less than three weeks away and its songs have already got noticed. Yesterday, the team behind the film announced that the much-awaited trailer will be out tomorrow, November 11. Bollywood Hungama has now learned that the makers have even organized an event to unveil the trailer.
A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “The trailer launch of films usually happens in Mumbai. But the team of Gunmaaster G9 decided to adopt an out-of-the-box approach. Hence, they are all set to launch the trailer of the film in a multiplex in Pune.”
The source explained, “Pune has a huge fan base for Emraan Hashmi and is one of the top-performing centres of the country. Hence, it made sense for the makers and the cast to travel to Pune to launch the trailer of their film.”
Bollywood Hungama has learned that Gunmaaster G9 ’s trailer event will be held at City Pride in Pune’s Kothrud area. The source added, “The whole team will be present at the launch and hence, it’ll be one of the most memorable events of the year.”
Gunmaaster G9 ’s trailer was passed by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) with an ‘A’ certificate on November 5. It has a runtime of 2 minutes and 40 seconds. The source revealed, “The teaser and the songs have given a hint about the world of the film and its characters. The trailer will now give a clear understanding of the film’s plot and of course will be full of mass-appealing moments.”
Besides Emraan Hashmi, the action entertainer also stars Genelia Deshmukh and Aparshakti Khurana. It is directed by Aditya Datt with music by none other than Himesh Reshammiya. Gunmaaster G9 is produced by Deepak Mukut, Sangeeta Ahir and Hunar Mukut. The action musical entertainer releases in cinemas this month, on November 27.
